title: NFL Football
description:
Pittsburgh Steelers at Tampa Bay Buccaneers
The Tampa Bay Buccaneers host the Pittsburgh Steelers in NFL Week 6 at Raymond James Stadium. Tampa Bay (1-4) ended their four-game skid by beating Dallas behind 165 rushing yards from Bucky Irving. Pittsburgh (3-2) beat Indianapolis 34-22 last week.

title: NFL Football

The Las Vegas Raiders host the Buffalo Bills in Week 6. In week 5, Las Vegas lost 45-17 to the New England Patriots, leaving them at 3-2, while the Buffalo Bills beat the Los Angeles Rams 37-34 in overtime to improve to 4-1.
